scope.interactionChannel: real macOS secondary click and menu selection via cliclick

observations.name: Diff tab system menu
observations.detail: A real secondary click on the active Diff tab opens the macOS system menu with Close, Close others, disabled Close to the right, and Close all.

observations.name: Close others reverse state
observations.detail: Selecting Close others removes Files and retains the active Diff surface.

observations.name: Files tab Close to the right availability
observations.detail: A fresh seeded run opens the Files tab system menu and visibly enables Close to the right. The subsequent selection result was visually ambiguous and receives no physical outcome credit; reducer behavior is covered by focused tests.

closedProductLoss: Native right-panel tabs now expose the Web authority's system-native close lifecycle menu.
Close others has a physically verified reverse state.
Bulk tab closure releases a removed Terminal session instead of leaving its PTY history alive.
remainingProductLoss: Middle-click tab close remains unsupported in Native.
Copy path is available for file tabs but was not physically exercised in this run.
missingCoverage: Light theme and narrow sheet layout are not retained.
Close all and Close to the right physical outcomes are covered only by reducer/source tests.
harnessLoss: Lynxtron 0.0.16 did not register an owned DevTool client, so no DevTool console or computed geometry is claimed.
The copied snapshot points ReviewService outside its configured workspace root, so the visible Diff body error is fixture mismatch and not attributed to this tab-menu state.
classification.intentionalPlatformDelta: The menu uses native macOS material rather than Web popup pixels.

validation.productionBuild: pass with existing unsupported-CSS and Effect import.meta warnings
